verdict.rationale: Neon publishes a full public API (openapi.json), an official CLI wrapping it, and a documented MCP server, covering project/branch/database management, auth, and most operations available in the UI (branching, autoscaling, connection pooling, restore, etc.). missing for 10: no explicit independent confirmation that every single UI action (e.g. billing/team management nuances) maps 1:1 to API endpoints, and no third-party audit of API completeness vs UI.
